full_judgment: 12. As recorded hereinbefore, in making this unlawful/illegal appointment, the respondent No. 2 has relied upon a letter addressed to her by 7 elected members, vide a letter dated 22-9-2014, for appointment of Mr Golam Sarwar as the President of the GB. Having scrutinized the concerned regulation we find no provision authorizing the aforementioned 7 (seven) members to make any recommendation to the Board Chairman (respondent No.2), nor any authority has been vested in the Board Chairman to take their recommendation into account. But, without following the provisions of the concerned regulation, the then Board Chairman has appointed Mr Golam Sarwar (added respondent No.5) as President and, as such, she has made clear violation of the regulation and cared not at all about the source and limitation of her authority. Hence, we find, that this is a fit case where she (the then chairman of Dhaka Board) should be fined with exemplary amount, so that no one, by using his or her position makes such order which is bound to erode the Rule of law, so nakedly.
